title: Can't stop "pump unreachable" alarm
body:
This had happened before several weeks ago. I get a "pump unreachable" alarm beeps in the middle of the night. Half awake, I hit "Ok" and do a manual refresh.

Then the alarms starts again. I don't see any window with buttons to stop it. I swipe all the AAPS messages in Android (still half awake and without glasses)... But the alarm goes on. Refresh pod status does not change anything.

3 dots menu, quit AAPS. Alarm stops but AAPS restarts by itself and the alarm too, except that the sound is different.

I had to force stop AAPS and empty cache memory to stop the alarm.

Logs at around 02:13

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1653956051074.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8802253/AndroidAPS_LOG_1653956051074.log.zip)

Phone near me, I'm probably sleeping on my arm on the pod. Pod unreachable alarm. I mute or OK (not sure as I don't have my glasses and just woke up). I actualized Dash pod and it worked ok. Then, it looked as if AAPS had just restarted : no more predictions and the progression bar at work. The unreachable alert sound was there again but no message and no way to turn it off.

I quit AAPS via the 3 dots menu. As usual AAPS starts again by itself. This time, the alarm sound is still there but the sound has changed (a kind of blip) but there still is no message to turn off the alarm.

I had to kill AAPS and clear cache in order to stop the alert.

Logs attached. Look a bit before 5AM.

Closed for inactivity. Create new issue is if you still see the problem on latest branch
